text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah...!
This is a grave situation, Trainer-kun!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: My heart races in anticipation—the fiery passion surging within me feels like it's about to burst out of control!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
La la la~♪ The one who'll triumph in this battle is the Overlord~♪
Namely me, the "End of the Century Overlord"~♪

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
An overwhelming power before whom all shall kneel~♪
Her name is T.M. Opera Oooo~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, having unleashed all her inner urges,
TM Opera O headed off to the race in high spirits.
